item.title: Gene Therapy Safety Concerns
item.description:
• Summary: Reports link gene therapy using viruses to a tumor in a boy, and raise concerns about cancer risks in patients with Mucopolysaccharidosis type I (Hurler syndrome), highlighting safety challenges for the field.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: STAT News, STAT News

item.title: Tessera In Vivo Sickle Cell Therapy
item.description:
• Summary: Tessera has revealed the strongest data to date for its in vivo sickle cell therapy, demonstrating significant efficacy in patients with this rare genetic blood disorder.
  • MoAs: In vivo gene therapy (gene editing)
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: Encoded Therapeutics Dravet Syndrome Study
item.description:
• Summary: A study by Encoded Therapeutics for Dravet syndrome evaluates the safety tradeoff of sirolimus, highlighting the balance between seizure reduction and adverse effects in this rare epilepsy.
  • MoAs: mTOR inhibition
  • Sources: STAT News
